findings.message: Training needs about 331.42 GiB per GPU but H100 SXM (80 GB) has 80.00 GiB. Weights 38.96 GiB, gradients 38.96 GiB, optimizer 233.74 GiB, activations 19.76 GiB.
findings.hint: Model state dominates. Raise the ZeRO stage from 0 to 3, or increase tensor parallelism.

findings.message: The sinks are counted as FlexAttention runs them: one fused kernel that skips the blocks the mask removes, with the sinks applied to the log-sum-exp it returns, so the score matrix is never kept for the backward pass.
findings.hint: The generated model compiles flex_attention on CUDA. Anywhere else, or where it cannot compile, it computes the same attention over the whole score matrix, which is exact but unfused, and is what a CPU verifies and profiles.

findings.message: 15000B tokens is 207.9x the compute-optimal budget of 72B. Heavily over-trained, in the range of small models trained on very large corpora.
findings.hint: This is fine when inference cost matters more than training cost, which is usually why it is done.
